name: projects-pack-delegation
description: Install bounded local PR and optional AWS qualification clients for the private Projects service.

interface.shortDescription: Use the private Projects service with bounded local PR effects.
interface.longDescription: The authenticated Projects service owns coordination, lifecycle, review, acceptance, and readiness decisions. This public component installs a bounded local Git and GitHub runner plus a separate opt-in local AWS qualification command. Projects retains each single-use dispatch reservation. The package cannot mark ready, merge, deploy, or run candidate verification locally.
defaultPrompt: Use the authenticated Projects service for this tracked work.
